item.title: Iran’s rights body condemns France’s crackdown on peaceful protesters
item.description: Iranian judiciary-affiliated human rights body condemns France’s violent crackdown on nationwide peaceful protests.

item.title: New power poles, Resistance Front to challenge US tech monopoly: Iran’s Basij chief
item.description: Hossein Taeb says the Resistance Front has fundamentally disrupted the strategy of the global arrogance to subjugate independent nations through a monopoly on cutting-edge technologies.

item.title: Iran drafting 1406 budget on ‘zero oil’ scenario to shield economy against blockade: Official
item.description: A Plan and Budget Organization official announces an emergency economic roadmap, ruling out Central Bank borrowing as domestic production neutralizes Washington’s blockade.

item.title: US evacuates aircraft from second UK base involved in war on Iran due to alleged threat: Report
item.description: The United States moves military aircraft from a second airbase in Britain following what US officials described as a potential threat from Iran.

item.title: Iran’s Vienna mission slams Grossi’s ‘selective outrage’ over attacks on nuclear facilities
item.description: Iran’s permanent mission to international organizations in Vienna has sharply criticized IAEA Director General Rafael Grossi for applying a clear double standard in his response to attacks on nuclear facilities.

item.title: Qalibaf warns of ‘dark age’ if US doesn’t abandon ‘Israel First’ policy
item.description: The Iranian Parliament speaker warns of disastrous consequences of the United States’ “Israel First” agenda.

item.title: Transfer of highly enriched uranium not on Iran’s agenda: FM spokesman
item.description: Iran rules out transferring its highly enriched uranium to another country under a potential deal with the US.

item.title: Source: No negotiations with US until it takes practical steps on Iran's seven conditions
item.description: A senior Iranian security official, speaking to Press TV, has ruled out any plans for negotiations with the US, saying Tehran's position on talks remains unchanged until Washington takes practical steps to meet its seven conditions.

item.title: China calls for political solution to end US-Israeli war on Iran
item.description: Iran and China stress diplomacy and political solutions to end US-Israeli aggression and restore stability across West Asia.

item.title: Leader ordered Iran’s officials to end state of ‘neither war nor peace’: Pezeshkian
item.description: The Leader has instructed Iranian officials to put an end to the current state of neither war nor peace, the president said on Monday.

item.title: ‘Sheer lies’: IRGC rejects Trump’s claims of Hormuz control, mine clearance
item.description: The Strait of Hormuz is “completely closed,” Brigadier General Hossein Mohebbi, the IRGC spokesman, said on Monday.

item.title: Iran-Russia trade expansion hinges on resolving private sector hurdles: Official
item.description: A trade official emphasizes the need to translate strategic bilateral agreements and the EAEU Free Trade deal into actionable logistics, secure payment mechanisms, and joint value chains to capture a larger share of the Eurasian market.

item.title: In Marseille, hundreds march in support of high school students
item.description: Several hundred people march through the center of Marseille in support of the high school students’ movement.

item.title: Bahrainis continue to show solidarity with clerics amid arrest campaign
item.description: Bahrainis continue to show solidarity with Shia clerics amid an arrest campaign targeting 25 individuals.

item.title: UNICEF warns of worsening winter risks for children, displaced people in Gaza
item.description: UNICEF has warned of the escalating risks threatening the lives of children and the displaced in the Gaza Strip.
